name: managed-review-prompt-gate-contract-gaps
title: Close the managed-review prompt/gate contract gaps
description: Six managed-review gates enforce invariants that no reviewer prompt states, so a compliant-looking reviewer completes a full review and is then refused. Each gap costs one wasted review round to discover. Found during B-137a across roughly fifteen review rounds; framework-wide, not B-137a-specific. Five are prose gaps in the managed-review protocol (readCount semantics, verbatim routing-digest copy, manifest/log list equality, exactly-one submission, repository-relative paths) and the sixth, recorded in B-137a as F-299, is the same failure in code: readManagedHostRunBinding trusts archive.binding after only a runId check while its sibling import-seal reader re-digests it against archive.evidenceBindingDigest. DEPENDS ON B-137a (INIT-001): every source location cited by this story lives in packages/main/src/core/managed-host-run.ts and managed-review-evidence.ts, which exist ONLY on the unmerged story/B-137a branch. On main those modules do not exist at all; the pre-split equivalent is packages/main/src/core/host-run.ts and it contains no readManagedHostRunBinding. A worktree cut from main therefore cannot locate the cited code. This story must not enter DEV until B-137a merges to main, and the cited line numbers must be re-resolved against the merged tree because they will have shifted.
